name: 3M Littmann Cardiology IV Stethoscope, Hunter Green
seoTitle: Hunter Green Littmann Cardiology IV Gift
metaDescription: The Littmann Cardiology IV in hunter green with a 27 inch tube. A rich, classic color for a nurse who wants a premium stethoscope that stands apart.
summary: A Cardiology IV in deep hunter green, a classic color that stands out from the sea of black and navy stethoscopes on most units.
whyItWorks: Walk onto almost any unit and you will see a lot of black and navy stethoscopes. Hunter green is a quietly different choice, rich enough to feel special but subtle enough to go with any scrubs color. For a nurse who has been using the same school stethoscope for years, a Cardiology IV in a color they would not have picked for themselves can feel like a real treat.

The Cardiology IV line is one of Littmann's most recognized, and it is often what nurses have in mind when they talk about an upgrade. Giving it for the holidays, a work anniversary, or a move to a new specialty shows you understand how much they rely on the tools they carry. The title lists a 27 inch tube, which is a common length that many nurses find comfortable to wear around the neck through a long shift. A green stethoscope is also easier to spot at a crowded nurses station, which saves a little hassle when everyone sets theirs down at once.
goodToKnow: Check the listing for chestpiece and stem finish so you know the full look.
Ask a coworker whether they already own a Cardiology IV before buying.
A personalized stethoscope ID tag makes a nice small add on.

faq.q: Is hunter green a good color for a gift?
faq.a: It is a safe yet distinctive pick, since green pairs easily with most scrubs colors and stands out from common black and navy.

faq.q: Who is the Cardiology IV best for?
faq.a: It is a popular choice for nurses in critical care, cardiac, and advanced practice roles, but any nurse who wants a premium stethoscope can enjoy it.
